description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Declaring that the Posts on the staff of the Secretary General of Parliament to Pensionable Posts
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns public service administration, specifically declaring certain parliamentary staff positions as pensionable posts. It involves public sector service conditions and benefits under the Parliamentary Staffs Act, falling clearly within Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) which cover public service recruitment, service conditions, and pension benefits. While it mentions the Speaker and Minister, it does not focus on government structural changes or individual appointments with portfolio responsibilities, making it distinct from government-related classifications (Types 1-3).
